description: This file contains serialization and deserialization functions for objects, including handling of function references, import references, and special object types like Date, RegExp, and URL. It also includes error handling for JSX components.

classes.name: FunctionRef
classes.description: Type representing a function reference with a type identifier and an ordinal index.

methods.name: isFunctionRef
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a FunctionRef.

methods.name: wrapObject
methods.description: Serializes an object, replacing functions with references.

methods.name: unwrapObject
methods.description: Deserializes an object, replacing references with actual functions or imported values.

methods.name: transformObject
methods.description: Recursively transforms an object based on a mapping function, handling special types and throwing errors for JSX components.

methods.name: transformObjectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version of transformObject, handling promises during transformation.
